messages.subject: Advanced Distance Sampling book discount
parts:
Hi Distance-sampling list,

As many of you will be aware, our new edited book Advanced Distance Sampling is due
out late this summer (expected publication in September). Oxford University Press
have sent us a promotion code that gives a 20% discount to those ordering the book
online (you can only place advanc orders at present, but they also qualify for the
discount). There is also the same discount for the Introductory book. There are
no geographic restrictions to this offer - although you have to pay shipping!

More details about the book and the discount are at
http://www.ruwpa.st-and.ac.uk/distance.book/
which you can also get to from the usual Distance page
http://www.ruwpa.st-and.ac.uk/distance/

- Len Thomas
